movie.title: Neglected
movie.overview: Detective Shaw is about to retire when he finds out on his last day of work that a serial killer has buried his son alive. He then races against the clock to solve three murders and find his son’s location before he runs out of air.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: On his final day before retirement, Detective Shaw must solve three murders in a race against time to rescue his buried-alive son before his oxygen runs out.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Detective Shaw's final day on the police force takes a harrowing turn when he receives devastating news: a ruthless serial killer has kidnapped his son and buried him alive. To uncover his son's hidden location, Shaw is forced to navigate a twisted game created by the killer, requiring him to solve three seemingly unconnected murder cases before time runs out. With every passing hour depleting his son's finite oxygen supply, the veteran detective must rely on every instinct to unravel the clues. It becomes a frantic, high-stakes race against the clock where failure means losing the person who matters to him most.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Detective Shaw is looking forward to a peaceful life as he prepares to clock out for the very last time on his final day before retirement. However, his plans are shattered when a chilling message from a notorious serial killer reveals that his son has been buried alive in an undisclosed location. The sadistic culprit offers Shaw a single, terrifying chance to save his child: he must successfully solve three separate, gruesome murders within a strict time limit. Driven by desperation and fatherly love, Shaw dives headfirst into the cases, desperately searching for the underlying thread that connects these violent acts. As he pushes through city streets, interrogates witnesses, and decodes cryptic clues, the psychological toll begins to weigh heavily on him. The police force rallies around him, but the killer remains two steps ahead, constantly mocking Shaw's frantic efforts. With his son’s oxygen steadily depleting in a underground coffin, every second counts and every mistake could prove fatal. Shaw is forced to cross professional boundaries and face his own past mistakes as the investigation reaches its fever pitch. In a heart-pounding race against time, the detective must outsmart a criminal mastermind before his son draws his final breath.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Neglected is a high-octane thriller centered on Detective Shaw, a seasoned investigator standing on the threshold of retirement. What should have been a routine farewell turns into a horrifying nightmare when a relentless serial killer target's Shaw's own family, burying his son alive in a secret subterranean grave. To receive the coordinates that will save his child's life, Shaw must unravel a labyrinthine web of crime by solving three intricate murder cases left behind as morbid puzzles. As the clock ticks down and the pressure mounts, the narrative weaves high-stakes action, intense drama, and suspenseful detective work to explore the desperate lengths a father will go to protect his son.

story_structure.climax: With time running out and oxygen expiring, Shaw faces the final confrontation to force the location of the hidden grave out of the suspect.
story_structure.conflict: A suspect surrenders at the precinct with a chilling ultimatum, revealing he has buried Shaw's teenage son alive with a limited supply of oxygen.
story_structure.resolution: Shaw locates and rescues his son just in time, leading to a personal awakening about his family priorities and his role in law enforcement.
story_structure.introduction: Veteran Detective Shaw prepares to conclude his career on his last day before retirement, burdened by strained family relationships.
story_structure.risingAction: Shaw races against the clock to investigate three linked murder scenes, decoding cryptic clues and navigating psychological mind games to track down his son's location.
